content.short: Rainbow Swap is a DEX aggregator on TON that scans multiple pools to find the best exchange rates for users.
content.description: Rainbow Swap is a powerful decentralized exchange aggregator built for the TON blockchain. It functions by scanning multiple liquidity sources across the ecosystem, such as STON.fi and DeDust.io, to route trades through the most efficient paths. This ensures that users always receive the best possible exchange rates and minimal slippage for their swaps. Rainbow Swap simplifies the trading process by providing a single, optimized interface for all Jetton swaps, enhancing the overall efficiency of the TON DeFi market.
content.meta: Get the best rates on TON with Rainbow Swap, the premier DEX aggregator. Explore on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
